description: Checks whether AI crawlers and AI search tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Copilot) can read and cite a public URL: robots.txt rules for GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, Applebot-Extended and Bytespider; text and H1 in the raw server HTML; llms.txt and llms-full.txt; JSON-LD types; title, description, Open Graph, canonical, sitemap; nosnippet/noindex; and agent readiness: loads the page with the User-Agents of OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, GPTBot and ClaudeBot to catch firewall/CDN blocks robots.txt doesn't show, Content Signals, Link headers, Markdown negotiation (Accept: text/markdown), WebMCP forms and registerTool calls, and MCP server card, AI catalog and API catalog discovery. Passive GETs of public URLs only. Returns a 0-100 score and fixes.

url.description: Public web page to check, e.g. example.com or https://example.com/pricing

name: ai_visibility_check
title: AI visibility check
